text: Cooking is the process of transforming raw ingredients into food that can be consumed. Simmering is a cooking technique where ingredients are cooked in water or other liquids for a longer period of time, resulting in a moist and tender dish. Seasoning is a cooking technique that involves adding fresh herbs, spices, or other ingredients to enhance the flavor of food. Once the dish is cooked, it can be served for both appetizers and main courses.
